welfare_convergence.note: Under a stationary-binomial null (no change, iid draws), regression to the mean predicts slope = early reliability. Slope well below it rejects that simple null; the windows are not stationary, so this is suggestive, not a dynamical convergence result. The identity intersection a/(1-b) is where the fitted cross-prompt line meets late = early, not an identified training fixed point; bootstrap draws with slope >= 0.95 are dropped and counted.
